entities.summary: Fabrice Vetea Santoro is a French former professional tennis player. Successful in both singles and doubles, he had an long professional career, with many of his accomplishments coming towards the end of his career, and he is popular among spectators and other players alike for his demeanor and shot-making abilities; he also plays two-handed on both the forehand and backhand sides.
